# Book of Giants Fragment 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 4Q530 col. vi (Cave 4) | **Condition:** moderately well preserved; epistolary format

---

**6:1** [...] This is a copy of the second letter tablet [...]

**6:2** [...] written by Enoch, the interpreter and scribe [...]

**6:3** [...] addressed to all who live on the earth [...]

**6:4** [...] and to the Watchers [...] You should know this [...]

**6:5** [...] your appeal will never be granted [...]

**6:6** [...] To the Watchers and the giants: Know this — your actions [...]

**6:7** [...] your actions and your wives' actions [...]

**6:8** [...] have testified against you [...]

**6:9** [...] Your requests will be denied [...]

**6:10** [...] from now until the end of time [...]

**6:11** [...] your wives [...] your children [...] because of your sexual sins on the earth [...]

**6:12** [...] destruction and imprisonment have fallen upon you [...]

**6:13** [...] the land will be taken from you [...]

**6:14** [...] because you chose corruption [...]

**6:15** [...] and violence and the shedding of innocent blood [...]

**6:16** [...] the sentence of judgment will fall on you [...]

**6:17** [...] and the judgment of the great flood [...]

**6:18** [...] is coming upon you and your descendants [...]

**6:19** [...] You will be chained in the deepest places of the earth [...]

**6:20** [...] until the eternal judgment [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Fragment 6 (Enoch's Response to the Giants). Source: 4Q530 col. vi. The PNEUMA translation prioritizes readability and natural modern English, rendering the ancient Aramaic in a way accessible to contemporary readers. Imagery is vivified and syntax restructured for impact while remaining faithful to the underlying meaning. Square brackets indicate genuine gaps in the surviving manuscript fragments from Qumran Cave 4.*
